en.headline: Smoother language switching
notes: Language and theme changes no longer show the interface while its controls are being rebuilt.
The Language, theme, and Settings buttons keep the same size when switching between English and Chinese.
The Settings window keeps a fixed size and stays open when you switch language or theme.
This release also includes the Unlock Files workflow for PDFs and Excel workbooks from version 0.4.0.

zh.headline: 更流畅的语言切换
notes: 切换语言或主题时，不再显示界面控件重建过程中的空白状态。
在英文和中文之间切换时，语言、主题和设置按钮保持相同尺寸。
设置窗口保持固定尺寸，切换语言或主题时也会继续打开。
本版本还包括 0.4.0 中新增的 PDF 和 Excel 工作簿解锁功能。
